description: Create the administrator account that activates a Google Workspace order — the step that turns a paid order into a usable Workspace. It submits the customer's own name and contact details to Google, so only call it with details the account owner gave you for this purpose, and never invent them.

alternate_email.description: A recovery address OUTSIDE this domain — Google uses it if the admin is locked out.

domain.description: The domain the Workspace order belongs to.

email_address.description: The admin mailbox to create, e.g. admin@example.com.

name.description: Optional. Account holder name, if it differs from the admin name.

name: impreza_google_setup_admin
